Implemented `Strata::new` in `/workspace/src/strata.rs`:

- Build `DiGraphMap<&Ident, ()>`; add every relation from `relations` as a node first (so relations with no rules/deps still get a stratum, which `make_stratum`/`find_relation` in `lib.rs` require).
- Add edge `goal -> fact` for each dependency pair (caller inserts `(&rule.goal.relation, &fact.relation)`, negated clauses included).
- `algo::tarjan_scc` → each SCC is one stratum (mutually recursive relations evaluated together), returned in reverse-topological order, so a relation always lands after everything it depends on — matches `lib.rs`'s "guaranteed by reverse topological order" / `assert!(goal_stratum > fact_stratum)` and the same-stratum negation abort.
- Build `index` mapping each ident → stratum position. Ident equality is by name, so use-site idents resolve to declaration nodes.

Tests written by me: `mod own_tests` in `src/strata.rs`, 10 cases — empty, isolated relations, linear chain ordering, mutual recursion collapsing into one stratum, self-loop, recursive cycle + tail (Edge/Tc/Out), SCC with neighbours, diamond partial order, use-site vs declaration idents, and the `find_relation` panic message. Each also asserts the strata form an exact partition of the input relations with consistent indices.

Ran: `cargo test --release --lib` (10/10 pass) and the repository suite `bash /repo2env/test.sh`. Suite is green — 25 test targets, 0 failures, including `test_negation`, the trybuild UI test `recursive_negation` (unstratifiable negation still aborts with the expected message), and doc-tests.

FROM peb-remake/ekzhang-crepe:hardened

# These images end on a non-root USER, so a RUN inherits it and the layer below cannot write.
USER root

# the carve: every function body in the target file becomes a throwing statement
RUN set -eu; cd /workspace; \
    printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > 'src/strata.rs'

# and the tests that describe it go too -- writing tests is part of the task
RUN set -eu; cd /workspace; \
    rm -f 'tests/test_showcase_all_features.rs'; \
    rm -f 'tests/test_transitive_closure.rs'; \
    true

# the history holds the file that was carved out; seal it away from the agent
RUN set -u; if [ -e /workspace/.git ]; then mkdir -p /root/.forge-sealed-git && mv /workspace/.git /root/.forge-sealed-git/git; fi; rm -rf /workspace/.git

WORKDIR /workspace
